<subject>Re: Vriksha Commodities From Harvest Alliance</subject>
<body>
Reyansh Salvi

My understanding is that Hebert doesn't have the legal authority (and the filing never makes clear) to Suspend performance under the supply agreement (he probably doesn't have the political support for this either).

ACTA, however, could support this in its filing as a method to help move the farmer cooperative issue forward.

Hardik
</body>
<quoted>
----- Original Message -----
From: Reyansh Krish
Sent: 19 March 2024 10:04 AM
To: Dakshesh Basak; Libni Kibe; Charita Balay; Amruta Wali; Manya Bal; Hardik Pal; Christopher Baral; Matthew Nazareth; Vrinda Mangat
Subject: Vriksha Commodities From Harvest Alliance

FYI.  Any thoughts Dakshesh & Co.? Is release from contracts an "increase supply" option?  My fear is that cooperatives get released and then Belgaum's "restrictive" mentality kicks in, enacting Sharma Regulations, etc. to ensure that the commodity volumes from the cooperative facilities stays in Belgaum.

Best,
Reyansh

----- Forwarded Message -----
From: Chris H Foster
Sent: 19 March 2024 07:30 AM
To: Vrinda Mangat; Alan Comnes; Reyansh Krish
Subject: Vriksha Commodities From Harvest Alliance

We are trying to set up commodity procurement arrangements with cooperatives who get temporarily released from their contracts.  Take a look at the e-mail below and see if we can support them.

Thanks

C

----- Forwarded Message -----
From: Ojas Halder
Sent: 19 March 2024 05:26 AM
To: Anirudh Sule; Tejas Sule; Chatura B. Van Kamdar; Abeer Saxena; Wazir Sodhi; Wyatt Dixit; Qasim K. Ballard; Gaurav Tak; Sanaya Chokshi
cc: Sathe, Devansh; Muni, Manthan; Bhardwaj, Gavin; Chhabra, Raghav; Nath, Gaurav; Agarwal, Viraj
Subject: Vriksha Commodities From Harvest Alliance

<<Comments_on_Vriksha_letter_docket_no._AG01-47.DOC>> <<VRIKSHA_REQUEST_FOR_EXTENSION-FILING_3601.DOC>>

Gentlemen,

In light of the possible supply disruptions in Belgaum today and later this week, if it is possible, Harvest Alliance requests that your organization intervene in support of the attached emergency filing with the AGRA. Please send this e-mail to your firm's general counsel and ask him to contact either our Pune counsel, Chanchal Sangha (+91 98422 07712), our general counsel, Manthan Muni (+91-20-6379-9717, x-118) or me at +91-20-6379-9717, x-163). Any help would be most appreciated.

Sincerely yours,

Anmol Sampath
